name: Angie's Restaurant (Logan, UT) Classic Chef Salad (Ham, Turkey, Egg & Jack)
whyItWorks: Packed with lean protein from hard-boiled eggs, smoked ham, and roast turkey breast. In stable remission, the protein helps balance the leafy greens.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Chef Salad with ranch dressing on the side; hold raw tomato slices if sensitive to nightshade acid.
watchOuts: Raw salad greens require active remission to digest comfortably
